verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own Collection Runner executes many requests in one run, and the Inso CLI automates those runs. That is a form of bulk execution across many items. The evidence does not show general bulk item management, such as bulk edit, delete, move or tag across requests or collections. missing for 10: bulk edit/delete/move of many items, bulk operations beyond request execution, AI-driven bulk actions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Use the Collection Runner to send multiple requests in a specific order
Automatically test multiple requests in your collections, with unlimited collection runs.
Use the Insomnia CLI to automate the execution of your API tests using your existing Git workflows.
